text:
Priya Sharma: Quick heads-up — candidate for Senior Infra (on-site loop) is starting in ~30m. Two quick asks: 1) who’s taking debrief lead, 2) where are the test-account creds, and 3) candidate requested +15m accommodation.

Maya Chen: I can be backup debrief lead if Jordan wants primary.

Jordan Lee: I’ll take debrief lead. Can someone drop the test account + a short checklist here? Also confirming we can give the extra 15m.

Elena Rodriguez: Confirmed — extra 15m is fine. For the test account creds, use the vault link (restricted) but I’ll paste a short ephemeral snippet below for the interview machines (rotate after use):

Elena Rodriguez: ```ssh -i ~/.ssh/interview_key_2026.pem ubuntu@10.42.20.5
password: (rotated via vault) — do NOT share outside this thread```

Samir Patel: Quick note — the infra exercise touches a prod-like cache. Please ensure the candidate is told not to run any destructive scripts. I added a one-line warning to the doc: "DO NOT RUN migrate.sh on interview host".

Jordan Lee: Good call. Priya, can we have people-ops send the standard non-disclosure + recording consent line to the candidate? We recorded consent earlier but want it explicit before the system design.

Priya Sharma: Will ping the candidate now. Also tagging @RecruiterBot to add the interview to the candidate record.

RecruiterBot: Candidate record updated — interview start logged 2026-11-02T15:00Z. Note: accommodation (+15m) saved.

Elena Rodriguez: Small rubric clarification: for this role we prioritize system reliability reasoning and cost-aware design. Please score 'fault isolation' and 'operational runbook' separately — there are two numeric fields.

Samir Patel: Also prefer concrete examples over abstract bullet points. If they reference prior systems, ask for failures and mitigations.

Jordan Lee: During debrief, focus on tradeoffs and whether the candidate proposed observable SLIs. That’s the main tie-breaker.

Maya Chen: Room logistics — Conference Room B has HDMI + whiteboard. If you need screen-sharing with the candidate (remote), use the Guest Zoom link I posted in the calendar event.

Priya Sharma: Final checklist for interviewers: 1) join 5m early, 2) open rubric in Google Drive (link on event), 3) respect extra 15m, 4) don't run destructive commands, 5) I will collect debrief notes in the doc and ping for scores.

Elena Rodriguez: Got it — I’ll be in Room B at T-10.

Jordan Lee: Thanks everyone. Priya — if candidate wants to reschedule last-minute, can you let ops know?

Priya Sharma: Yep — will coordinate. :thumbsup:
